# Data Source: appwrite_webhook

Fetches an Appwrite webhook by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_webhook" "slack" {
  id = "64f2cd7e27bda9f23ab6"
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value = data.appwrite_webhook.slack.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The webhook ID.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The webhook creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `events` (List of String) Events that trigger the webhook.
- `name` (String) The webhook name.
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether TLS verification is enabled.
- `updated_at` (String) The webhook last update timestamp.
- `url` (String) The webhook URL.
